source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the receptors of pain and touch (PDF 45-46).

blocks.text: Jild ke mukhtalif receptors (cutaneous receptors) lams, dabao, garmi, thand aur dard par jawab dete hain.

Nociceptors dard pakarte hain, jise aisa muharrik kaha gaya hai jo tissue ko nuqsan de raha ho ya dene wala ho. Yeh poore jism mein, khaas kar sateh ke qareeb, free nerve endings hain; mukhtalif nociceptors shadeed darja-e-hararat, bohat zyada dabao ya khaas kimiyai maddon par jawab dete hain, jin mein zakhmi cells se nikalne wale bhi hain.

blocks.title: Thermoreceptors
blocks.text: Thermoreceptors nange dendrite sire hain jo darja-e-hararat ka girna aur barhna pakarte hain: thand ke receptors epidermis ke bilkul neeche aur garmi ke receptors thora gehre dermis mein hain. Hypothalamus ke thermoreceptors khoon ka darja-e-hararat, yaani jism ka andaruni (core) darja-e-hararat, dekhte rehte hain.

blocks.alt: Jild ka tukra: epidermis, dermis aur charbi ki teh. Baal epidermis se guzar kar apne follicle mein jata hai jis ki jar par hair follicle receptors lipte hain. Free nerve endings epidermis tak pohanchte hain, Merkel cells epidermis ki tah par, Meissner corpuscle dermis ke oopri hisse mein, Ruffini ending dermis mein gehra aur Pacinian corpuscle charbi ki teh mein; sab aik sensory nerve se jure hain.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Free nerve endings (pain, heat, cold), Merkel cells (touch), Hair follicle receptors (touch & movement), Meissner corpuscle (touch), Ruffini endings (pressure & stretching), Pacinian corpuscle (pressure).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har receptor ki gehrai par dhyan dein: free nerve endings sab se oopar epidermis tak (dard, garmi, thand), Merkel cells epidermis ki tah par aur Meissner corpuscle uske theek neeche (halka lams), hair follicle receptors baal ki jar par (baal hilna), Ruffini endings dermis mein (khinchao aur dabao) aur Pacinian corpuscle sab se gehra charbi mein (gehra dabao). Kitab ki figure mein 'Markel cells' chhapa hai; sahi naam Merkel cells hai.
Yeh receptors sensory neurons ke zariye impulses spinal cord aur phir dimagh tak bhejte hain, jahan signals lams ke ehsas ban jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa receptor batata hai ke bhaari kitab haath par dab rahi hai, aur kaunsa ke par (feather) ungli ke sire ko chhoo raha hai?
blocks.explanation: Gehra dabao: Pacinian corpuscles (aur musalsal dabao ke liye Ruffini endings). Ungli ke sire par halka lams: Meissner's corpuscles aur Merkel cells.

items: Nociceptors: dard ke liye free nerve endings. Lams: Meissner's (halka lams, tharthrahat), hair follicle, Merkel (halka lams), Pacinian (gehra dabao), Ruffini (khinchao). Thermoreceptors: thand aur garmi, aur hypothalamus mein.
